caption: The drawing features a horizontal band running through the center, adorned with an array of floral and botanical motifs. The background of the band is a light beige or tan color, and both sides outside the band are plain off-white. Within the band, there are various flowers in shades of pink, red, yellow, blue, and green. The flowers differ in size and shape, some with rounded petals and others with jagged or pointed edges. Interspersed among the flowers are green leaves and winding vines, some of which twist and curl throughout the length of the band. There are also small buds and berry-like shapes in red and blue, as well as a few decorative elements with dotted and dashed lines in green and yellow. The overall composition is linear, with the plant and floral elements stretching horizontally across the band from left to right, creating a continuous, interconnected pattern. The drawing appears to be divided into three sections by two vertical fold lines.
title: Crewel Embroidery
